LESSON: LANGUAGE USE

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.9: Language Use

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Language Use. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can you improve your speaking skill?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognise objects from an oral text
2. describe positions of objects in relation to others for comprehension
3. appreciate speaking skills to convey information accurately

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: LANGUAGE USE
This lesson teaches Language Use for Grade 6 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. recognise objects from an oral text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. describe positions of objects in relation to others for comprehension
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate speaking skills to convey information accurately
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Language Use using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Language Use above.
2. Explain Language Use to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Language Use.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Language Use with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Language Use important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you improve your speaking skill?
2. Why does the position of objects affect their description?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. recognise objects from an oral text
2. describe positions of objects in relation to others for comprehension
3. appreciate speaking skills to convey information accurately

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
